other_conditions: Must be pursuing a BA/MA/PG in mass communication, journalism, public relations, MBA (Marketing) or related fields from any recognized college/university
Must have own laptop for the internship
Undergraduate students must have appeared in term‑end exams of the 2nd year/4th semester and secured at least 60% in 12th class
Recent graduates/PG students must have appeared in final exam or just completed graduation/PG and secured at least 55% cumulative marks
Post‑graduate students must have appeared in term‑end exams of the 1st year/2nd semester or be pursuing research/PhD and have at least 55% in graduation
Must attend full‑time internship physically at the main secretariat
Work hours are 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM unless otherwise permitted
Must follow department rules and regulations
Internship is not a job or employment assurance
Must maintain confidentiality and not disclose department information
benefits_summary: Interns receive a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000, a certificate on successful completion, and access to working space and internet facilities provided by the department.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
